html:
G'oya

Har bir o'tkazmani (yuboruvchi, oluvchi, kun, summa) to'rtligi deb qarang. Uning qaytarilgani bormi, bilish uchun jadvalni ikkinchi marta, ikki ustunini almashtirib olamiz: (oluvchi, yuboruvchi, kun, summa). Ikkala ro'yxatda ham bor to'rtlik qaytarilgan o'tkazma. Bu kesishma, INTERSECT.

Yechim

SELECT sender_id AS user_a, receiver_id AS user_b, sent_on, amount
FROM transfers WHERE sender_id < receiver_id
INTERSECT
SELECT receiver_id, sender_id, sent_on, amount
FROM transfers WHERE receiver_id < sender_id

Birinchi qism kichik id katta id'ga yuborgan o'tkazmalarni oladi, ikkinchisi teskarisini, lekin ustunlarni almashtirib. 7-foydalanuvchi 1-ga 50 000 yuborgan, u ikkinchi qismda (1, 7, '2024-05-12', 50000) bo'ladi va birinchi qismdagi 1-ning javobi bilan kesishadi. Takrorlarni INTERSECT o'zi olib tashlaydi.

Tuzoqlar

user_a < user_b shartisiz har bir holat ikki marta chiqadi: (1, 2) va (2, 1).

Shartni ikkala qismga bir xil yozish ham xato: ikkinchi qism ustunlar almashgani uchun teskari tartibdagi juftliklarni beradi va kesishma doim bo'sh.

Noto'g'riSELECT sender_id, receiver_id, sent_on, amount FROM transfers WHERE sender_id < receiver_id
INTERSECT
SELECT receiver_id, sender_id, sent_on, amount FROM transfers WHERE sender_id < receiver_id

Kun va summani unutmang. 3 va 4 o'rtasidagi 80 000 ertasi kuni qaytarilgan, 5 va 6 o'rtasida esa summalar har xil. Ikkalasi ham qaytarilgan o'tkazma emas.

Boshqa yo'l

JOIN bilan ham bo'ladi, lekin bir kunda bir xil o'tkazma ikki marta bo'lsa (namunada 1-dan 7-ga ikki marta), juftliklar ko'payadi va DISTINCT kerak:

SELECT DISTINCT a.sender_id AS user_a, a.receiver_id AS user_b, a.sent_on, a.amount
FROM transfers a
JOIN transfers b ON b.sender_id = a.receiver_id AND b.receiver_id = a.sender_id
                AND b.sent_on = a.sent_on AND b.amount = a.amount
WHERE a.sender_id < a.receiver_id
